sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bound to upstream intent and broker policy. A SAML assertion with an Issuer not matching the configured provider metadata must not be accepted; and token exchange must validate the subject_token audience so a token minted for client-A cannot be exchanged at client-B to gain permissions for a different audience.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control: valid SAML login should succeed so later rejections are meaningful.
I5: issuer mismatch must be rejected; otherwise broker may accept assertions outside configured trust/policy context.
I5: token exchange must not allow a subject_token minted for client-A to be exchanged using client-B credentials (audience/client binding).
